ampQuarks[0] = FCFAConvert[CreateFeynAmp[diagsQuarks], IncomingMomenta -> {pH}, OutgoingMomenta -> {k1, k2}, List -> False, ChangeDimension -> 4, DropSumOver -> True, SMP -> True, Contract -> True, UndoChiralSplittings -> True, FinalSubstitutions -> {MQU[l] -> SMP["m_q"]}]
